name: Variations
roadmap: Variation describes how quantities change in relation to others. Start with Direct and Inverse variation graphs. Then, progress to the multi-step Partial variation (DSE Section A/B). Mastering percentage changes in variation is critical for Section B success.
roadmap_zh: 變分描述了各量如何隨其他量而改變。由正變及反變圖像開始，進而學習多步驟的部分變（DSE 甲部/乙部）。掌握變分中的百分比變化是乙部取分的關鍵。

concepts.name: Direct Variation (Linear)
concepts.key_takeaway: In direct variation, the graph of $y$ vs $x$ is a straight line through $(0, 0)$. The ratio $y/x$ is always constant.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 在正變中，$y$ 對 $x$ 的圖像是過 $(0, 0)$ 的直線。$y/x$ 的比值始終為常數。

concepts.name: Inverse Variation (Hyperbola)
concepts.key_takeaway: In inverse variation, as $x$ increases, $y$ decreases. The graph of $y$ vs $x$ is a hyperbola that never touches the axes.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 在反變中，隨 $x$ 增加，$y$ 會減少。$y$ 對 $x$ 的圖像是雙曲線，永不與坐標軸相交。

concepts.name: Linearized Inverse Relation
concepts.key_takeaway: A powerful DSE strategy: plotting $y$ against $1/x$ produces a straight line through the origin, confirming inverse variation.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: DSE 的重要策略：將 $y$ 對 $1/x$ 作圖會得到過原點的直線，以此確認反變關係。

concepts.name: Constant & Varying Parts
concepts.key_takeaway: Partial variation sums different behaviors. This always requires setting up simultaneous equations to find $k_1$ and $k_2$ from two sets of values.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 部分變結合了不同的變動規律。這通常需要從兩組數值建立聯立方程來求取 $k_1$ 及 $k_2$。

concepts.name: The Multiplier Method
concepts.key_takeaway: If $x$ increases by $r\%$, $y$ increases by $(1 + r\%)^{n} - 1$. Don't forget to auto-square or cube the percentage multiplier if the power $n > 1$!
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 若 $x$ 增加 $r\%$，則 $y$ 增加 $(1 + r\%)^{n} - 1$。如果冪 $n > 1$，別忘了對百分比乘數進行平方或立方運算！
